scope: Local manual source/native review of one fixed program and nine complete numeric linked ranges, including ELF mapping-label continuations. Internal inspection, not independent external review or a general validator.
boot_binding: Fresh Image/vmlinux/configuration, unchanged inherited verifier and initramfs/tool/firmware inputs verified. Normal verifier, no offload/test modes, no disk/network/attachment; held FDs 3/4, relocation zero, initial key 1 is 41.
native_review: All 98 words inspected and match prior fixed native bytes. Entry-error and NULL branches skip value accesses; lookup operation 0 uses BLRS c17. Word 72 copies full c0 to c7; words 75/77 use unchanged c7 for the sole eight-byte value load/store. Word 78 carries the computed scalar result; RET c30 enters the executive return and RETR c16 restores the tagged caller. PLT has no reachable edge in this program.
linked_review: Lookup checks map table and key, dispatches to the reduced provider, and preserves full c0 through the gateway. Provider checks the retained root and map/key profile, uses SCVALUE/SCBNDSE with logical value_size, checks exact shape/perms, then preserves the full capability across logging and return. Allocator derives/checks/stores the retained full root; entry constructs restricted/executive ranges and installs c17/c18. The complete exception handler clears the encoded destination and installs the encoded fixup; its test-evidence flag is zero.
changed_words: 29 linked words differ from the prior image: relocated string addresses, the same kmalloc_caches slot at offset 0x188, and the relocated zero test-evidence flag. Control flow, capability checks, transport and accesses are unchanged. String referents and symbol locations were inspected.
limits: One valid program; no observed negative spatial access, padding discriminator, original CVE replay or whole-program mediation theorem. DDC/gateway retain broader authority. Constructed-operand telemetry is not hardware attestation.
recorded_preflight_scope: Preflight covered one ordinary TEST_RUN on the held descriptors. Execution and postflight outcomes are recorded separately.
